data.name: Diganta
data.gender_notes: Diganta is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Diganta is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dig' meaning sun and 'anta' meaning end or horizon. It represents the rising sun, a symbol of new beginnings and enlightenment. In Hindu mythology, Diganta is the name of the god Indra's chariot, which is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune. The name Diganta carries the meaning “Sunrise, Brilliance, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Diganta usually hope their child will grow to embody sunrise, brilliance, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of enlightenment and new beginnings.
data.etymology: Diganta belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sunrise, Brilliance, Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Diganta total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Diganta has a rich cultural significance in Hinduism. It is believed that the sun god, Surya, travels across the sky from east to west and rises in the east every day. Diganta represents this renewal of energy and life as the sun rises and brings new light and possibilities with each day. The name is also associated with the horse-drawn chariot of Indra, the god of thunder and rain, symbolizing prosperity and good luck.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the sun is considered a powerful symbol of life, energy, and consciousness. The rising sun is a reminder of the unending cycle of life, death, and rebirth. Diganta is a name that embodies this spiritual significance and invokes a sense of hope, renewal, and enlightenment, inspiring those who carry this name to live with a sense of purpose and steadfast determination in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Diganta symbolizes the rising sun, the embodiment of new beginnings, knowledge, and enlightenment. It is the name of the god Agni, symbolizing the sacred fire that illuminates the path to spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Diganta is mentioned as the land of the setting sun in various Hindu texts. It is believed to be located in the eastern direction, possibly the easternmost part of the Indian subcontinent.
The Buddhist text Mahaparinibbana Sutta describes Diganta as the place where the Buddha attained Parinibbana (final nirvana) after his death.
